{{Quote|For the ultimate dessert, sample this deluxe, Cloud City-style dessert prepared with three massive scoops of Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream--denta bean, Trammistan chocolate and beebleberry--and garnished with flavorful toppings, atomically aerated cream, crushed ettel nuts and real Ecclessis figs.|Dex's Diner on its Tibanna split|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Trammistan chocolate ice cream''' was a flavor of [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] that tasted like [[Trammistan chocolate]]<ref name="Menu" /> and shared its name with the [[Trammis system/Legends|Trammis system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the [[Foodstuff/Legends|ice cream]] in [[Cerean cone]]s and as part of its [[Tibanna split]] desert. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] used [[Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream]] brand of Trammistan chocolate ice cream for its Tibanna split.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trammistan chocolate ice cream was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
